visual_summary: A large faceted metallic structure or vessel has come down amid smoke and dust on a barren landscape. It is surrounded by multiple animal-like creatures: large reptilian beasts on the ground and manta- or bird-like fliers overhead. A speech balloon from the central machine/entity rejects the creatures as food. In the lower panel, the scene erupts into a bright explosive or sonic impact as the surrounding creatures attack, with dialogue indicating a hyper-infrasound weapon has been activated.
